full_judgment: 2. The short facts relevant for disposal of the Rule is that the proceedings in Special Case No.10 of 2009 arising out of Metro Special Case No.186 of 2008 ACC, ACC G.R. No.116 of 2008 and Motijheel Police Station Case- No.144 dated 30-03-2008- has been challenged by invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Court as laid down under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure on the facts that one Md. Shafiuddin Mollah, Assistant Engineer, Design, RAJUK, lodged a First Information Report with Motijheel Police Station, alleging inter alia that in processing of promotion against vacant posts, 4 of his colleagues had been entrusted with the current charge as Assistant Engineer from amongst one was junior to him. During Office hours someone told him to meet the petitioner and accordingly he met the petitioner in his office room at about 12.00 AM who said whether there can be any promotion without spending money. Having been proposed so the informant got himself embarrassed and came back. After 10 days he was told that he may be given current charge if he pays Taka 5,00,000/-. At the relevant time most of the appointments, transfers and promotions were not possible without interference of said Amir Khasru. By communicating the administrative section and being advised therefrom, he agreed to pay the petitioner a sum of Taka 3,00,000/- and thereafter on the instruction of the petitioner, he submitted an application to the Chairman, RAJUK, on 02.12.03 for the purpose. Subsequently vide Memo No: RAJUK প্রঃ শাঃ/১৬-৫০ অংশ ২১/১৬৪০ dated 08.12.03 he was entrusted with the current charge. Soon after getting the current charge Amir Khasru had been pressing and threatening him for payment of the said amount and being compelled he made payment of the said amount from his National Bank, Dilkusha Branch, Account vide cheque No.7.392058, dated 20 10.04. Since the accused had been the president of Jatiotabadi Sromik Dal, RAJUK Unit and member of- the Central Committee, the F.I.R. could not be lodged in time for fear of him. Basing upon the above First Information Report, Motijheel Police Station Case No.114 dated 30.03.08 under section 161 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 had been started against the accused petitioner.
